name: Passive Heater
description: A block that heats a boiler without fuel.

pages.title: Passive Heater
pages.text:
A **passive heater** heats a Create boiler with no fuel: Farmer's Delight's Stove, Twilight Forest's fiery storage blocks, lava, magma blocks, campfires and fire.\
\
It is weaker than a Blaze Burner, but free.
